notes: Step-03 mechanism baseline: one level, three populated lateral flows and ACC in both matched cases.
Five aircraft are requested in each flow at a fixed 90 s per-flow headway; 0/30/60 s phases create a combined 30 s cyclic request stream.
Policy groups contain the focal aircraft and up to two available predecessors/followers in its logical flow.
The rolling controller uses a 60 s degradation warning and an additional 60 s common action evaluation.

The 100 m research grid is retained conceptually, but the three populated flows are 300 m apart so parallel lanes satisfy the exploratory 200 m horizontal screen before longitudinal staggering is considered.
Only adjacent populated-flow changes are allowed; target insertion, induced ACC response and all-aircraft Cartesian 3-D separation are screened.
A candidate must improve focal integrated policy cost by at least 10 policy-cost seconds; this explicit mechanism threshold excludes one-sample oscillatory gains and remains uncalibrated.
All time, radio, ACC, motion and separation values remain exploratory research assumptions.
Capacity and throughput are deliberately not estimated.
